hero.title: A Kenya-wide youth-led consortium
hero.description: BNS is a collaborative force of media, policy, and creative experts turning public finance into a national conversation.

mission.heading: The BNS Mission
mission.description: We help young people understand how budgets shape jobs, healthcare, education, and the cost of living. By combining fiscal analysis with creator-led storytelling, we increase literacy and demand accountability.

impactCard.heading: National Scale Participation
impactCard.description: Our consortium reach extends into digital economy governance and equity, scaling through Project TERRA to reach 20k+ youth.

partners.name: Sen Media & Events
partners.description: Specializing in high-impact media events and civic storytelling that bridges the gap between policy and the public.

partners.name: The Continental Pot
partners.description: A leading platform for Pan-African narratives, focusing on governance, equity, and sustainable development across the continent.

partners.name: Colour Twist Media
partners.description: Experts in digital creativity, producing compelling visual content that mobilizes youth and simplifies complex fiscal data.

activities.title: Simplified Storytelling
activities.description: Translating technical budgets into relatable TikToks, Reels, and Podcasts for mass consumption.

activities.title: Grassroots Organizing
activities.description: Establishing university and community chapters to build a nationwide network of budget trackers.

activities.title: Impact Monitoring
activities.description: Generating real-time snapshots that compare fiscal promises with actual community delivery.

activities.title: Verification Hub
activities.description: A shared evidence desk for journalists and youth to fact-check budget claims with data.
